title: [ML/data] CROSS-VENUE TRAINING LABELS: the pooled setup_candidates / trade_outcomes families train on is_backtest=1 rows produced by scripts/ml/backtest_augment_runner.py, which replays the harnesses on the Binance-vision USD-M feed (regime_debt_matrix.emit_trades_for), while the models SERVE on Bybit (the live venue; market_raw is Bybit V5). Measured venue gap (relay #27576, 2023-01..2026-11): close diff median 0.88-1.32 bps, highs/lows max 155-381 bps; on trend_donchian_eth the venue alone moved the book +4.26 R -> -2.61 R (422 of 451 trades matched, per-trade median dR ~0, mean -0.036). Do: measure the share of is_backtest=1 rows in each live/advisory pooled dataset (rows and label-weight) and, if material, the label disagreement rate between Binance and Bybit replays of the same trades; then decide (data) whether the augment should replay on trainer Bybit files.
